title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: For nearly 30 years I have offered counselling and psychotherapy to children and adults . I have trained extensively in a number of modalities in addition to talking therapy – Mindfulness-based therapy, Jungian Sandplay Therapy and Embodied Imagination dreamwork.

name: Janeeta Ray
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Informed by a client centred, strengths based approach, I work with clients seeking to understand their patterns of feeling and responding, especially when navigating life's challenges: loss, parenting, relationships, finding meaning and purpose. Together we work to find compassion for self and a greater ease through a range of therapeutic modalities including Internal Family System (IFS), Schema, Acceptance and Commitment (ACT), Interpersonal and Mindfulness therapies, amongst others.

name: Mia Maria Toliopoulos
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Located centrally in Port Melbourne in beautiful calming rooms, we support men and women over 40, struggling with anxiety, overwhelm, stress & depression to learn simple life skills through compassionate & connected conversations to enable day to day tasks to be achieved, to live happier and more fulfilled lives.
